Assembly worker

What are you going to do?
As an assembly employee for excavators at Hitachi in Amsterdam, you will help build, test, and improve components for modern excavators. You will work full-time in day shifts and start on a 40-hour temporary contract, with the prospect of being taken over by Hitachi if you perform well.

What do we offer?
- A gross hourly wage between € 17.00 and € 20
- 27 vacation days and 8% holiday allowance
- Travel allowance of €0.25 per km
- Growth opportunities within technical production
- Free online training via the Adecco Academy
- Pension contribution from day one

Where will you work?
You will work at Hitachi Construction Machinery Europe N.V. in Amsterdam-Westpoort. This is a modern and international production site where innovation, safety, and craftsmanship are central. The location is easily accessible from Zaandam, Haarlem, and the Amsterdam region, both by car and public transport.

Through Adecco, you will have a dedicated contact person who supports you. We help you with training, job satisfaction, and your next career step. ﻿

What do we ask?
- Demonstrable experience in assembling or technical mounting
- Experience in hydraulic systems and mechanical assembly.
- Good technical insight and understanding of mechanics
- You speak Dutch or English
- You work accurately, safely, and independently
- A team player with a practical and solution-oriented mindset

Are you interested?
Ready for your new job in technical production in Amsterdam-Westpoort? Apply before August 28, 2026 via the application button.
